text:
alex: Quick broadcast — adjusting release train gating policy for this cycle. New rules below and the canary window is shifted to Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please read and ack.

alex: TL;DR: tighten pre-canary smoke checks, enforce per-model perf guardrails, and move non-critical DB migrations out of weekend window. Exceptions require eng-release + eng-sre signoff.

alex: New checklist (short):
- run `make smoke` on canary images
- confirm latency P95 <= baseline + 10%
- no >1% error rate for 5m after rollout
- tagging: add `release:gated` to PRs that must follow canary

maya: Ack — clear. Where's the doc?

alex: https://redwood.internal/runbook/release-gates (perm: eng-release)

maya: thx. One question — we have embedding-service queued for Tuesday deploy, does this change it?

sanjay: If embedding-service is non-critical, move to next calm window. If it's critical, we'll run through the stricter gating and keep it Tue but expect longer canary. ping me if you need help.

maya: It's low-risk but heavy tokens. I'll reschedule to Fri morning.

jen: Heads up: quota bump for dedicated seats was applied today; monitoring will show traffic shape differences. Can we add dedicated route to smoke tests?

alex: Good catch — ops-bot, add dedicated routing check to the smoke suite for this train.

ops-bot: added `check:dedi-route` to smoke pipeline for train-1764 :robot_face: 

release-bot: Automated note: rolling back to previous gating policy will require written approval. See /policies/release-gates.

sanjay: Also, embedding regression test failed locally for me (tokenizer mismatch). Debugging now, will post fix in PR.

maya: FYI — canary owners please leave brief notes in the canary thread when you flip the flag. One-line status is fine (eg: "canary up — 15m stable").

alex: To summarize action items:
- eng owners: follow new checklist + tag PRs
- eng-sre: watch SLA and be ready for rollbacks during Thu window
- release leads: approve exceptions via channel thread with reason + mitigation

jen: any change to freeze window?

alex: Freeze stays Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC. Exception process unchanged.

maya: ack. I'll move embedding to Fri and update the cadence doc.

sanjay: pushed fix for tokenizer mismatch, PR #4921. running smoke now.

jen: noted — monitoring dash updated to include canary heatmap.

alex: thanks everyone. If you hit blockers ping @sanjay or @alex and escalate in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

sanjay: quick command if you need to opt out of gating for emergency patch:
```
/optout release-gates --reason "emergency-fix" --owner @your-name
```
(ops approval required, logs retained)

maya: recorded, thanks.

alex: closing the loop — will post a short changelog snapshot tomorrow with final canary outcomes and any rollbacks.
